senses.gloss:
रेष् (ऋ) रेषृ r. 1st cl. (रेषते)
 1. To utter an inarticulate sound.
 2. To
neigh.
 3. To howl.
 4. To roar.

रेष् mfn. (रेट्) Who or what neighs, howls, &c.
 E. रेष् to neigh, विच् aff.

रेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded, made as a noise.
 n. (-तं) Neighing,
roaring.
 E. रेष् to sound, aff. क्त ।

रेष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) An injurer.
 E. रिष् to hurt, तृच् aff.
